annotations.title: List building blocks for a site

description: Lists ready-made building blocks for a site on Spaicely: a cookie notice that holds back analytics until the visitor agrees, forms that send to Spaicely without leaving the page, videos and maps that load only after a click, a mobile menu, an FAQ with structured data, a language switch, opening hours that say whether the place is open now, a progress bar for a donation form and a cart for the shop. Prefer a block to writing the same thing yourself. blocks.get gives a block's files, the HTML snippet for the pages and notes. Needs no account.
name: blocks.list
